name: Yanagawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yanagawa city emblem in green: a stylised figure of two curved strokes with a disc, like a letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Yanagawa, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 March 2005.

features.role: Yanagawa city emblem — a stylised figure of two curved strokes with a disc, like a letter V
